reservedMissingCache.rule: Do not import before the required negative case. Verify actual absence at that boundary; absence of an import record is not current engine-state proof.

derivation: Both archives retain the original layers and runtime configuration. Each configuration adds only its distinct test-fixture label, producing distinct immutable manifest digests. No mutable tags, registry push or shared-image pruning.
preservation: Saved before/after projections match source image, engine identity, version, context, Compose/plugin selection and container list. Independent reviewer checked archive rosters, member hashes, receipts and current input/tool pins without engine calls.
limits: This proves offline derivation and probe load/digest resolution. It does not prove NATS execution, actual cache absence, missing-cache runtime recovery, acquisition-failure recovery or P02 acceptance.
